I build data pipelines and turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone investigates factors associated engagement with emergency shelter programs
established by a local organization, Church at the Park.

I care about figuring out how to best leverage data to help organizations make informed decisions and innovations. 

**Currently looking for** Data analyst roles
starting May 2027. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
